description: This file defines the ThreadPool class, which models the configuration of a thread pool for the OFBiz framework. It includes attributes for setting thread pool parameters such as min/max threads, polling behavior, purge days, and related configurations, and parses these from XML elements.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: A class representing the configuration of a thread pool, initialized from an XML element, including thread limits, polling configuration, and related settings.

methods.name: getFailedRetryMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum retry delay in seconds for failed tasks.

methods.name: getJobs
methods.description: Returns the configured size of the job queue.

methods.name: getMaxThreads
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of threads in the pool.

methods.name: getMinThreads
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of threads in the pool.

methods.name: getPollDbMillis
methods.description: Returns the interval in milliseconds for polling the database.

methods.name: getPurgeJobDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days after which jobs are purged.

methods.name: getSendToPool
methods.description: Returns the name of the pool to which tasks are sent.

methods.name: getTtl
methods.description: Returns the threads' time-to-live (TTL) in milliseconds.
